description: This file defines the TopPosition struct in the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel.Shapes namespace, representing the top position attribute for shapes in document modeling. It includes constructors, property accessors, and methods for setting and retrieving position values, handling different data types and enum conversions.

external_files.description: Enum for shape positions (Top, Bottom, Center, Undefined)
Represents measurement units, possibly with parsing capabilities

classes.name: TopPosition
classes.description: Struct encapsulating the top position information in a shape, supporting enum and unit representations, with methods for setting and serialization.

methods.name: SetFromEnum
methods.description: Sets the shape position enum and resets the unit-based position.

methods.name: SetFromUnit
methods.description: Sets the position from a Unit and resets the enum position.
